scenes.text: Northwind is the warehouse operations platform built for distributors who outgrew their spreadsheets but can't justify SAP.
The problem: every order touches four different systems.
Your team rekeys the same SKU into your ERP, your shipping label printer, your inventory sheet, and your customer portal. Mistakes happen. Customers churn.
Scan a bin, print the label, update the ledger, notify the buyer. One action, four systems updated, zero retyping.
Customers ship 38% more orders per picker.
We integrate with NetSuite, ShipStation, Shopify, and your existing scanners. Onboarding takes a week, not a quarter.
